entities.summary: Christopher Michael Cardone, OP is an American Catholic prelate who has served as Archbishop of Honiara in the Solomon Islands since 2016. He is a member of the Dominican Order. Christopher Cardone was a religious figures from Brooklyn (b. 1957-12-20, Brooklyn). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
